groupDescription: The headline feature: a built-in MCP server lets Claude or any AI assistant build playlists, fix tags, organise your library and download tracks — private, local, and off by default.
label: AI Assistant
heading: Just ask — it’s done
description: Turn on AI control and an assistant running on your computer — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client — can do anything a listener does, and much of what a librarian does. Ask it to build playlists from your likes and history, fix tags across hundreds of tracks (in the library or written into the files), organise folders into a clean Artist/Album layout, save lyrics and covers next to your music, download tracks from your server or through download plugins, and swap low-bitrate copies for better ones in place. It can answer questions about your listening history, run playback, queue and radio, and use your installed plugins as tools too. A private control server runs on your machine only (127.0.0.1, token-protected), and the bundled MCP server presents it to assistants as typed tools. Deliberately bounded: anything that touches your files needs its own opt-in switch, moves and file swaps are planned and shown first, it can never delete files or install code, and every change is logged.
items: Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor & any MCP client — setup is two clicks
Playlists, tags, likes, radio, queue & playback — just ask
Fix tags in bulk, file compilations, save lyrics & covers, reorganise folders (plan first)
Download tracks and upgrade copies in place, with a side-by-side quality check
Plugin tools too: Spotify playlists, Soulseek search & moreplugin
Local-only, off by default — can never delete files or install extensions

groupDescription: Audiophile-grade playback and lean-back views, for listening and watching.
label: Engine
heading: Hear it the way it was meant to be heard
description: Gapless playback for seamless album listening. Crossfading from 0 to 10 seconds between tracks. Native codec support for audio and video files — no transcoding, no plugins.
items: Audio & video playback with native codecs
screenshotAlt: Vibo playback controls and now playing bar

label: Now Playing
heading: Lean back and watch the words
description: A full-screen now-playing view with synced, karaoke-style lyrics that highlight line by line. Playing a video? It expands into a distraction-free theater mode — just the picture, with the controls fading out of the way.
items: Video theater mode with auto-hiding overlays
screenshotAlt: Vibo now playing view with synced karaoke lyrics

label: Mini Player
heading: Always within reach
description: A compact, always-on-top mini player that stays visible while you work. Draggable, auto-resizing, and just the right amount of information at a glance.
items: Normal, compact or full layout — full keeps every control on screen
screenshotAlt: Vibo mini player with playback controls

groupDescription: Local folders and music servers, unified into one fast library.
label: Library
heading: Your collection, always in sync
description: Point Vibo at your music folders and it handles the rest. Background scanning reads metadata intelligently, and real-time file watching catches every change the moment it happens.
items: Smart metadata extraction with fallback parsing
Real-time file watching for instant updates
screenshotAlt: Vibo library albums in tiles view

label: Search
heading: Find anything in milliseconds
description: FTS5-powered full-text search across artists, albums, tracks, and tags. Accent-insensitive and forgiving — find what you want even when you can't remember the exact spelling.
items: Search by artist, album, track, or tag

label: Servers
heading: Local meets streaming, seamlessly
description: Point Vibo at local folders and Subsonic or Navidrome servers for one unified library. Add streaming services through plugins — they slot straight into the same player, queue, and search.
items: Spotify & YouTube browse and playbackplugin
screenshotAlt: Vibo collections view with local and server sources

label: Likes
heading: Your likes, on every device
description: Like and dislike tracks, artists, albums and tags — then carry that taste to another PC or profile. Export it all to a file and import it anywhere; because likes are matched by name, they re-apply cleanly even to a differently-scanned library. The merge is safe to run both directions — it only ever overwrites an older like with a newer one, and never deletes. Signed in to Last.fm? Pull your loved tracks straight in — once, or automatically on a schedule.
items: Like & dislike tracks, artists, albums & tags
Export & import all likes as a portable file
Newer-wins merge — carry it both ways safely
Import & auto-sync your Last.fm loved tracksplugin
screenshotAlt: Exporting and importing likes in Vibo settings

heading: A home screen that knows your library
description: Open Vibo to a curated landing page — an auto-rotating carousel of radio stations built from your own music, plus shelves that resurface recent plays, your most-played, and albums you'd forgotten you owned.

description: Start an endless station from any track, artist, or tag and Vibo builds the queue from what fits. When a queue runs dry, auto-continue keeps the music going using weighted strategies you control.

Tune stations: seed-artist share, favorites / mixed / discovery taste, spread across artists
Mix by same artist, tag, most-played, or liked

groupDescription: Shape the app around how you listen.
label: Keyboard
heading: Built for power users
description: Over 35 keyboard shortcuts for everything from playback to navigation. Never leave the keyboard — control your music as fast as you can think.

label: Skins
heading: Make it yours
description: Choose from 8 built-in skins or install community skins from the gallery. Import your own JSON skin files with 13 customizable color tokens and optional custom CSS.
items: 13 color tokens for full UI theming

groupDescription: An orchestrator at heart — extend Vibo with streaming services, metadata, and entirely new views.
label: Ecosystem
heading: Extend it your way
description: A JavaScript plugin system powers streaming, lyrics, artwork, scrobbling, and downloads. Built-in plugins ship with the app; install more from the in-app gallery, or build your own with custom views, home shelves, context-menu actions, and event hooks. You can even run Vibo with no local collection at all — the Spotify and YouTube plugins turn it into a pure streaming player.
items: One-click install from the in-app gallery
Custom sidebar views, home shelves & context actions
Per-plugin storage; structured views (no raw HTML)
No local files needed — stream via Spotify & YouTubeplugin
